title: Proportional ingress/egress charge model and security questionnaire response bundle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Evaluate a proportional ingress/egress charging model for the Hosted API that separates input (ingress) and output (egress) token rates into a single blended price with an optional per-minute streaming add-on, and package a templated Security Questionnaire (SQ) response bundle for enterprise contracts. Motivation: Customers on long-generation workloads (high egress) have raised fairness concerns about symmetric per-token pricing. Hypothesis: A proportional model that weights egress higher for generation-heavy routes will increase enterprise willingness-to-pay by 8-12% and lower billing dispute volume by >50% for affected accounts. The SQ bundle will reduce procurement lead time for enterprise deals by 2+ weeks.
experiment_design: 1) Define three pricing shapes: flat (control), proportional (ingress:egress = 1:1.5), and steep-proportional (1:2). 2) Apply to a small cohort of self-serve customers (n=120) and to an invite-only enterprise pilot (n=8). 3) Streaming add-on: optional per-minute charge for persistent websocket sessions with 10-minute free window. 4) Monitor revenue per active seat, contested invoices, and customer NPS for billing clarity. 5) Run for 30 days with interim checkpoints at day 7 and day 21.
success_metrics: >50% reduction in billing disputes for pilot cohort
No significant drop (>5%) in usage from self-serve cohort
<2ms median latency impact attributable to billing change (should be zero)
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal alignment and legal/SQ templating (week 0-2). Phase 1: self-serve A/B test on 10% of new signups and 5% existing low-risk users (week 3-6). Phase 2: invite-only enterprise pilots with dedicated contract language and SQ bundle (week 4-8). Phase 3: evaluate and iterate on metric outcomes; decision gate with Sales/Legal/Finance for wide launch or additional pilots.
acceptance_criteria: Metric-driven go/no-go: ARPU and disputes thresholds met; Sales sign-off on SQ bundle; Legal sign-off on contract addendum; Finance validates revenue model. If any criterion fails, hold rollout and run targeted mitigations for 4 weeks.
risks: Complexity in billing UI causing customer confusion
Increased accounting and invoicing work for Finance
Potential for gaming via synthetic ingress-heavy requests to reduce cost
Legal disapproval of per-minute streaming add-on for certain regions
mitigations: Add clear UI tooltips and example invoices in Console
Pre-bake accounting exports and mapping to Finance schema
Rate-limit path and detection heuristics for ingress-only abuse patterns
Engage Legal early and include regional opt-outs in SQ bundle
